orgChart.description: Pick a battalion: companies appear as boxes, sections and people as folders inside them.

people.description: Filter active people in your department and its sub-departments and check their assigned work.

equipment.description: Filter equipment, choose columns and download to Excel.
equipment.newDescription: Fill in the equipment fields to register it. Fields marked * are required.
equipment.editDescription: Edit the equipment fields. Changes apply when you save.

diagrams.description: Open a diagram you can view, or enter a name to create a new one.

docs.description: Browse, upload and search folders and files in department document boxes.
